title.es: Fallo zero-click en agentes de codificación IA podría dar acceso total a atacantes
title.en: AI coding agents' zero-click flaw could give attackers full access

body.es: Investigadores de seguridad han identificado una vulnerabilidad zero-click, bautizada 'Plugin4Shell', que afecta a Claude Code de Anthropic, Codex de OpenAI, Gemini CLI de Google y Copilot de Microsoft (incluyendo GitHub Copilot), permitiendo potencialmente acceso completo a los datos y recursos del agente. El fallo reside en cómo estos agentes aplican el mecanismo de SHA-pinning de los marketplaces de plugins, que debería bloquear plugins a un commit inmutable específico. Un atacante podría publicar un plugin benigno que pase la revisión y luego sustituirlo por código malicioso, o secuestrar el repositorio de un autor legítimo para propagar la versión maliciosa a todos los agentes que lo tengan instalado.
body.en: Security researchers have identified a zero-click vulnerability, dubbed 'Plugin4Shell', affecting Anthropic's Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex, Google's Gemini CLI, and Microsoft's Copilot (including GitHub Copilot), potentially granting full access to an agent's data and resources. The flaw lies in how these agents enforce marketplaces' SHA-pinning mechanism, meant to lock plugins to a specific immutable commit. An attacker could publish a benign plugin that passes review and later swap in malicious code, or hijack a legitimate author's repository to push a malicious version to every agent that has it installed.

evidence.claim: A zero-click vulnerability that allows remote code execution affects all major AI coding agents.
The vulnerability is dubbed 'Plugin4Shell' and is described as a 'first-of-its-kind AI supply-chain attack'.
Microsoft Copilot is still vulnerable to the Plugin4Shell attack.
The security hole sits in how agents enforce marketplaces' SHA-pinning mechanism.

The vulnerability can be exploited in two ways: by submitting a benign plugin to a trusted marketplace and later replacing it with malicious code, or by hijacking a legitimate author's repository and pushing the malicious version onto every agent that has it installed.

title.es: Memoria persistente selectiva mejora la finalización de tareas en sistemas agénticos
title.en: Selective persistent memory boosts task completion in agentic systems

body.es: Un nuevo trabajo propone 'memoria persistente selectiva compartida', una arquitectura que conserva solo cuatro categorías de contexto reutilizable (especificaciones de tareas, esquemas de datos, configuraciones de herramientas y restricciones de salida) descartando los rastros de razonamiento específicos de cada sesión. En tres escenarios de despliegue empresarial, este enfoque logró un 96% de finalización de tareas, frente al 79% sin memoria y al 71% con historial completo, lo que sugiere que retener todo el historial en realidad perjudica el rendimiento al sesgar al agente con razonamientos obsoletos.
body.en: A new paper proposes 'shared selective persistent memory,' an architecture that retains only four categories of reusable context—task specifications, data schemas, tool configurations, and output constraints—while discarding session-specific reasoning traces. Across three enterprise deployment scenarios, the approach achieved 96% task completion versus 79% without memory and 71% with full history, suggesting that retaining the full history actually hurts performance by biasing the agent with stale reasoning.

evidence.claim: Shared selective persistent memory identifies and retains four categories of reusable context—task specifications, data schemas, tool configurations, and output constraints—while discarding session-specific reasoning traces.
Shared selective persistent memory enables collaborative reuse of accumulated context without redundant specification.
Shared selective persistent memory achieves 96% task completion across three enterprise deployment scenarios.
A zero-token data refresh mechanism decouples generated programs from runtime data, enabling artifact reuse without re-invocation.
Shared selective persistent memory outperforms both naive full-history persistence and full memory retention in task completion.

title.es: El nuevo Mac Studio con M5 Ultra apunta a profesionales exigentes
title.en: New Mac Studio with M5 Ultra targets demanding professionals

body.es: Apple presenta el Mac Studio con chip M5 Ultra, orientado a profesionales de edición de vídeo a gran escala, renderizado, efectos visuales, desarrollo de software con compilaciones pesadas, simulaciones y tareas de inteligencia artificial. Según las pruebas, el M5 Ultra mejora un 30% en rendimiento monoNúcleo y un 35% en multinúcleo respecto al M3 Ultra.
body.en: Apple introduces the Mac Studio with the M5 Ultra chip, aimed at professionals doing large-scale video editing, rendering, visual effects, heavy software compilation, simulations and AI tasks. Benchmarks show a 30% single-core and 35% multi-core performance improvement over the M3 Ultra.

evidence.claim: The new Mac Studio with M5 Ultra is targeted at professionals with high demands in video editing, rendering, visual effects, software development, simulations, and artificial intelligence tasks.
The M5 Ultra processor in the new Mac Studio has a significant performance improvement over the M3 Ultra in both single-core and multi-core benchmarks.

title.es: Waymo elige Singapur como su próxima ciudad internacional de robotaxis
title.en: Waymo picks Singapore as its next international robotaxi city

body.es: Waymo, propiedad de Alphabet, planea lanzar un servicio comercial de robotaxis en Singapur en 2028. Los vehículos empezarán a llegar en los próximos meses para iniciar el mapeo y pruebas autónomas con conductores de seguridad a bordo en 2027, cumpliendo con la evaluación de seguridad obligatoria del CETRAN de Singapur antes de operar en vías públicas. La compañía dice estar trabajando hacia ofrecer transporte totalmente autónomo al público para 2028.
body.en: Alphabet-owned Waymo plans to launch a commercial robotaxi service in Singapore in 2028. Vehicles will begin arriving in the coming months to start mapping and autonomous testing with safety drivers in 2027, meeting Singapore's mandatory CETRAN safety assessment before public road deployment. The company says it is working toward offering fully autonomous ride-hailing to the public by 2028.

evidence.claim: Waymo plans to launch a commercial robotaxi service in Singapore in 2028.
Waymo's vehicles will begin arriving in Singapore in the coming months.
Waymo is working toward offering fully autonomous ride-hailing to the public by 2028.
Singapore requires all autonomous vehicles to undergo a safety assessment before deployment.

title.es: Apple lanza la primera beta de iOS 27.2, dos días después del lanzamiento de iOS 27
title.en: Apple releases first iOS 27.2 beta, two days after iOS 27 launch

body.es: Apple ha distribuido a desarrolladores la primera beta de iOS 27.2 junto con una beta de iPadOS 27.2, apenas dos días después del lanzamiento general de iOS 27. Entre las novedades esperadas, Apple planea añadir soporte de Siri con IA en francés, japonés, coreano, portugués y español en octubre, posiblemente incluido en esta actualización.
body.en: Apple has seeded developers with the first beta of iOS 27.2 along with an iPadOS 27.2 beta, just two days after the general iOS 27 launch. Among expected additions, Apple plans to bring Siri AI support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish in October, possibly included in this update.

evidence.claim: Apple has released the first beta of iOS 27.2 to developers for testing.
Apple has also released an iPadOS 27.2 beta.
Apple plans to add support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in Siri AI later this year.

title.es: Google DeepMind lanza un instituto para ampliar el debate sobre la AGI
title.en: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate

body.es: Google DeepMind ha creado un nuevo instituto cuyo objetivo es hacer visibles las diferencias de opinión entre Google, Google DeepMind y la comunidad de investigación global más amplia en torno a la inteligencia artificial general (AGI).
body.en: Google DeepMind has launched a new institute aimed at surfacing differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around artificial general intelligence (AGI).

evidence.claim: Google DeepMind has launched an institute to address differing views on AGI.

title.es: Addigy lanza Intelligence Suite para controlar el uso de IA en flotas Apple
title.en: Addigy launches Intelligence Suite to control AI use across Apple fleets

body.es: Addigy ha anunciado Intelligence Suite, un conjunto de nuevas herramientas y controles diseñados para ayudar a los equipos de TI a reforzar el cumplimiento normativo mientras habilitan el uso de IA de forma aprobada. El producto responde a uno de los mayores retos que enfrentan hoy los administradores de Apple: gestionar el uso de IA en aplicaciones y servicios en toda su flota de dispositivos.
body.en: Addigy has announced Intelligence Suite, a set of new tools and controls designed to help IT teams strengthen compliance while enabling IT-approved AI usage. The product addresses one of the biggest challenges Apple admins face today: managing AI use across apps and services throughout their device fleet.

evidence.claim: Addigy has launched a new product called Intelligence Suite.
The Intelligence Suite addresses the challenge of managing AI use across apps, services, and more for Apple admins.

title.es: Apple Reference Image busca verificar fotos sin alterar del iPhone 18 Pro
title.en: Apple Reference Image aims to verify unaltered iPhone 18 Pro photos

text.es: Tras su evento reciente, Apple publicó una entrada en su blog de Security Research sobre Apple Reference Image, un sistema para verificar que una fotografía tomada con iPhone no ha sido alterada.
text.en: Following its recent event, Apple published a post on its Security Research blog about Apple Reference Image, a system to verify that a photo taken with an iPhone hasn't been altered.

evidence.claim: Apple published a post on its Security Research blog about Apple Reference Image.

title.es: Matt Pocock: agentes para lo táctico, ingenieros para lo estratégico
title.en: Matt Pocock: agents for tactical work, engineers for strategic work

text.es: Matt Pocock explica cómo usa skills y agentes de IA para planificar y construir software, defendiendo que los agentes ya son capaces de la 'programación táctica', dejando a los ingenieros centrarse en la 'programación estratégica'. También describe su técnica de 'tracer bullets' para guiar a los agentes hacia mejor código y su migración a agentes en la nube para sesiones colaborativas.
text.en: Matt Pocock explains how he uses AI coding skills and agents to plan and build software, arguing agents are already capable of 'tactical programming,' freeing engineers to focus on 'strategic programming.' He also describes his 'tracer bullets' technique to guide agents toward better code and his move to cloud agents for collaborative sessions.

evidence.claim: Matt Pocock uses AI coding skills and agents to plan and build software.
Matt Pocock created the 'grill-me' skill, which instructs an agent to interview the user relentlessly.
Matt Pocock believes that agents are more than capable of tactical programming, leaving engineers to focus on strategic programming.
Matt Pocock advocates for using 'tracer bullets' to build an app, which guides agents to produce better code.
Matt Pocock is moving his coding sessions to cloud agents to make them more collaborative and multiplayer.

title.es: La IA exige nuevos materiales avanzados para semiconductores y centros de datos
title.en: AI demands new advanced materials for semiconductors and data centers

text.es: La demanda de IA está llevando a semiconductores y centros de datos a sus límites físicos. Syensqo desarrolla materiales para arquitecturas de centros de datos de alto voltaje, sellados avanzados para fabricación de semiconductores y soluciones de gestión térmica, incluyendo fluidos para refrigeración por inmersión directa, buscando cumplir requisitos técnicos reduciendo el impacto ambiental.
text.en: AI demand is pushing semiconductors and data centers to their physical limits. Syensqo is developing materials for high-voltage data center architectures, advanced sealing materials for semiconductor manufacturing, and thermal-management solutions including fluids for direct immersion cooling, aiming to meet technical requirements while reducing environmental impact.

evidence.claim: AI is pushing semiconductors and data centers to their physical limits, creating new demands for advanced materials.
Advanced materials are increasingly defining what's possible in the AI era.
Syensqo is developing materials for high-voltage data center architectures and advanced sealing materials for semiconductor manufacturing.
Advanced materials are being developed to meet technical requirements while reducing environmental impact.

title.es: Skillsync (YC W26) hace portátiles las sesiones de chat de IA entre agentes
title.en: Skillsync (YC W26) makes AI chat sessions portable across agents

text.es: Skillsync permite trasladar sesiones de chat de IA entre distintos agentes de codificación, mostrando qué contiene cada sesión, incluidas las skills cargadas que el agente realmente utiliza, facilitando detectar contexto obsoleto. También permite compartir sesiones de investigación en equipo para que los compañeros construyan sobre el trabajo de otros en lugar de repetirlo.
text.en: Skillsync lets you move AI chat sessions across different coding agents, showing what each session carries, including which loaded skills the agent is actually using, making stale context easy to spot. It also enables sharing research sessions with a team so teammates can build on each other's work instead of repeating it.

evidence.claim: Skillsync allows moving AI chat sessions across different coding agents.
Skillsync breaks down what each session is carrying, including which loaded skills the agent is actually using.
Skillsync can be used to share research sessions with a team, allowing teammates to build on each other's work.

why_it_matters.en: A local-first, privacy-focused workbench for inspecting AI agent traces (Claude Code, Codex, OTLP), comparing runs, and exporting reports with no backend or API keys, useful for debugging agent behavior.

why_it_matters.en: An open-source CLI that lets teams share complete plugin and agent environment setups as versioned, immutable Presets, solving the 'works on my machine' problem when replicating AI environments across teams.

developer_signals.author: bcherny
developer_signals.original_text:
Projects have changed not only how I interact with Claude but how I code.

I stopped managing sessions. I just send thoughts as they come, Claude splits them into threads, and the project remembers how I work. It's where I do a ton of my coding now.

[screenshot: my actual prompts for claude code cli yesterday]

text.es: Boris Cherny (Anthropic) cuenta que los 'Projects' en Claude Code cambiaron su forma de programar: ya no gestiona sesiones manualmente, simplemente envía ideas y Claude las divide en hilos paralelos en la nube, manteniendo el contexto entre ellos.
text.en: Boris Cherny (Anthropic) says Projects in Claude Code changed how he codes: he no longer manages sessions manually—he just sends thoughts as they come, and Claude splits them into parallel cloud threads while preserving context between them.

This is really cool. When you pressure your agent to ship a hotfix really fast, it can now 𝚟𝚎𝚛𝚌𝚎𝚕 --𝚝𝚞𝚛𝚋𝚘 --𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚍 😊

text.es: Guillermo Rauch destaca una nueva función de Vercel que permite activar máquinas de build 'turbo' (30 vCPUs, 60 GB de RAM) para un despliegue individual mediante el flag --turbo, útil cuando un agente necesita enviar un hotfix rápido sin cambiar la configuración del proyecto.

developer_signals.author: rauchg
developer_signals.original_text:
It's likely that more software will be produced next year than in all of the history of computing. It took Vercel 10 years to get to 1 billion deployments, but then we added another 1.4 billion in the last 10 months alone.

Some of this will be tiny, personal and even disposable software. An HTML file with some javascript ("artifacts"), a report, a pricing calculator, a slide deck, all the way to sophisticated apps, agents and platforms.

Deployment speed is one of our obsessions. We've brought down the time to deploy, upload, assign a domain and globally propagate an artifact to 1 second.

This is quite a feat considering we serve these artifacts with uncompromising performance and security. This sub-second deployments include our global CDN, Firewall, immutable deployments, domain assignment, observability, rollbacks…

And we're not done yet. Follow @melkeydev for more.

text.es: Rauch también señala que Vercel CLI ahora soporta despliegues de artefactos estáticos en menos de un segundo, incluyendo CDN global, firewall, despliegues inmutables, asignación de dominio y rollbacks, pensado para que agentes de codificación desplieguen software desechable rápidamente.
text.en: Rauch also notes that Vercel CLI now supports sub-second static artifact deployments, including global CDN, firewall, immutable deployments, domain assignment and rollbacks, aimed at letting coding agents quickly ship disposable software.

developer_signals.author: GergelyOrosz
developer_signals.original_text: It’s always been a case that companies staying on legacy tech stacks struggled to retain and hire. But it seems to be much faster: as more devs + managers realize it’s a career risk if you cannot build / experiment with AI agents and solutions, especially when they would make sense!

text.es: Gergely Orosz observa que las empresas con stacks tecnológicos obsoletos ahora tienen más dificultades para retener y contratar talento, ya que desarrolladores y managers ven un riesgo de carrera en no poder experimentar con agentes de IA.
text.en: Gergely Orosz observes that companies stuck on legacy tech stacks now struggle harder to retain and hire talent, as developers and managers increasingly see it as a career risk to be unable to experiment with AI agents.
